assessment.what_this_resolves: The downloaded comparator is specifically a UBOS 2006 County / Level 4 product, and its KINKIIZI feature is explicitly labeled as a Kanungu County, Uganda feature in its DBF. The registered geoBoundaries feature is a distinct 2006 Kinkiizi candidate with its own OSM/Wikimedia source attribution. The independent UBOS comparison reproduces a 64-key spatial association under the embedded .prj projection.
assessment.crs_assessment: The archive is internally inconsistent: .prj and ArcGIS processing lineage support custom UTM 36N with 200000 m false northing for the stored shapefile, while ArcGIS coordinate-reference fields and ISO19139 say UTM 36S / EPSG:32736. The ISO geographic bounding box is also incompatible with the described Uganda coverage and the stored shape bounds. The native-catalog record does not name a specific native CRS. The file-level evidence makes the .prj interpretation the best-supported reading for this overlay, but does not fully authenticate the producer's intended CRS/version or erase the contradictory metadata.
assessment.what_remains_unresolved: Neither same represented year nor the official UBOS comparison proves that this separate county polygon applies as a territorial exclusion to the original 2019 RGC/OCHA Rutshuru target. The 41 outside all UBOS polygons are not clearance evidence. No whole-cell physical qualification or original source/native diagnostic was run for these 105 keys.
assessment.disposition: All 105 remain pending and held. No repair, owner change, hold removal, package completion, or accepted science credit is proposed by this CRS/provenance review.
assessment.next_reasonable_step: Use the exact UBOS feature identification/geometry version evidence alongside the original 2019 competitor operands and original #2453 contract to determine whether the 2006 Ugandan county feature is an applicable contextual competitor for any exact COD key; do not infer a legal sovereignty finding or a positive repair from center overlap. If that contextual test is insufficient, perform the original stock physical/source/native qualification only where the original contract and admissible evidence support it; retain adverse or missing-coverage keys held.
